newyork-bos-2026-07-16-item-4.plain_english: No subject stated in the minutes; see the official record.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-item-1.plain_english: Approves selection and acquisition of a park site in Queens Community District 2 for a walk-to-park project.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-item-2.plain_english: Approves a land use application with modifications and refers it to the City Planning Commission.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-item-3.plain_english: Approves a land use application with modifications and refers it to the City Planning Commission.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Fina.plain_english: Establishes a temporary program for the Commissioner of Finance to resolve certain outstanding Environmental Control Board judgments resulting from default decisions.
Approves new designations and changes to designations of certain organizations to receive funding in the Expense Budget.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Gove.plain_english: Codifies the current flag of Staten Island as its official flag.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Cons.plain_english: Establishes an Office of Insurance Affordability to provide consumer insurance information and guidance and track legal actions alleging deception.
Addresses measures to mitigate the rising cost of property insurance for affordable housing.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Hous.plain_english: Makes the Certification of No Harassment pilot program permanent, with updated program lists published by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development every three years beginning April 15, 2027.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Park.plain_english: Establishes a pilot program requiring the Department of Parks and Recreation to designate volunteer-led dog run groups to collect dog feces from dog runs.
Requires the Commissioner of Parks and Recreation to post signs at park entrances, exits, and facilities summarizing rules against leaving dog waste and associated penalties.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Civi.plain_english: Declares August 2 annually as James Baldwin Day in New York City.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Tran.plain_english: Expands the City's outdoor dining program by removing seasonal restrictions on roadway cafe operation and permitting weatherproofing and winterizing materials for year-round operation.
Allows sidewalk cafe operators to enclose year-round sidewalk cafes annually from November 30 through March 31 and permits weather protection materials during other times of the year.

Requires roadway and sidewalk cafe operators to maintain their outdoor setups free of trash, debris, graffiti, vermin, food scraps, and unsanitary conditions, with violations subject to civil penalties.
Completes environmental review process for Proposed Int. No. 894-A under New York State Environmental Quality Review Act.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Sani.plain_english: Requires the Department of Sanitation to install at least 1,200 dog waste bag dispensers on public litter baskets across all five boroughs.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Publ.plain_english: Requires the New York City Police Department to report quarterly on confirmed firearm discharges, including date, time, and location of each incident.

newyork-bos-2026-08-13-Committee-on-Land.plain_english: Approves selection and acquisition of a park site in Queens Community District 2 for landmarks designation.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124983.plain_english: Adopts the 2026 Citywide Position List, which defines the authorized city jobs and positions.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124984.plain_english: Transfers responsibility for collecting coins from parking payment devices from one department to another.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124985.plain_english: Schedules a public hearing to clarify rules about assessment escalations for the Ballard Business Improvement Area.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124986.plain_english: Schedules a hearing to modify the boundaries and assessment structure of the Capitol Hill Business Improvement Area.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124988.plain_english: Expands eligibility and adjusts terms for City Light Department's emergency bill assistance program for utility customers.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124989.plain_english: Revises water service rates and credits for low-income customers, and authorizes withdrawal of funds from the Water Fund Revenue Stabilization account.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124990.plain_english: Expands eligibility and adjusts terms for Seattle Public Utilities' emergency bill assistance program.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124992.plain_english: Establishes a Do Not Solicit List to protect homeowners from unwanted solicitation to sell their residential property and creates an enforcement process.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124994.plain_english: Extends temporary zoning regulations for six months that exempt certain housing projects meeting Mandatory Housing Affordability requirements from specific zoning restrictions.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124996.plain_english: Updates city policy for enforcement of possession and use of controlled substances, amending related sections of the Seattle Municipal Code.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124998.plain_english: Grants FH, LLC (Skyline) permission to construct and operate a pedestrian skybridge across 8th Avenue in the First Hill neighborhood.

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-124999.plain_english: Considers The Yew, LLC's petition to vacate a portion of an alley in the Wallingford area (8623 Palatine Avenue N).

seattle-bos-2026-08-04-item-125048.plain_english: Appropriates and orders payment of claims submitted for the week of July 20–24, 2026, and ratifies prior related acts.

seattle-bos-2026-07-21-item-124651.plain_english: Establishes new retail rate schedules for City Light and creates a new customer class for data centers with large electricity demand.

seattle-bos-2026-07-21-item-124652.plain_english: Authorizes ten-year agreements between City Light and customers participating in transportation electrification programs.

seattle-bos-2026-07-21-item-124653.plain_english: Transfers control of the Lake City Garage and Plaza from the Department of Finance and Administrative Services to Seattle Parks and Recreation.

seattle-bos-2026-07-21-item-124661.plain_english: Authorizes a ballot proposition for November 3, 2026 asking Seattle voters to approve a sales and use tax to fund transit and related transportation.

seattle-bos-2026-07-21-item-124709.plain_english: Appropriates funds to pay approved claims submitted for the week of July 6–10, 2026.
